title: Terry L NDE 20268
content: I was in a coma for five days. On one of those days I heard a heart monitor go off, it was mine. I was looking down at my body and noticed there was a dead person covered from head to toe with a sheet onto my right. I floated as a white glow surrounded my being. Down below where my body was a doctor that I could plainly hear was saying that he was not going to lose another one and started to do CPR. I did not want to return to my body and I waved my arms so that he would stop but he did not notice me at all. I returned to my body. When I awoke from coma I no longer feared death!

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Suicide attempt Life threatening event, but not clinical death Overdosed.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I could not think when I was in my body but when I was out I could think clearly.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was fully awake and alert.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning There was no time and for space I did not think about it.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Just the sounds of the doctor and the heart monitor.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain A white Glow that was around me.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I could move my arms and even speak not in words.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I needed to learn more.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: No I did not want to go back but I did not have a choice.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I used to think I knew about God and heaven but now I can say I don't know and I am happy with that!
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: No Freedom from the chains of the body and Earth.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I hear warnings about appending doom and sometimes know what is going to happen before it does, but cannot control it. I write and do not know what I have written until it's been already written like poems.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Not fearing death. Coming back to my body.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes They did not believed me but I do not care!
